description: This file defines the BinaryComparison class, which provides methods for comparing strings and other data types with specific rules, including case-insensitive comparison modes and floating-point tolerance. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet calculation calculations module.

classes.name: BinaryComparison
classes.description: Provides comparison methods for strings and other data types, used internally in spreadsheet calculations for evaluating expressions and formulas.

methods.name: strcmpLowercaseFirst
methods.description: Compares two strings using a case-reversal approach so that lowercase letters come before uppercase in comparison, used for locale-specific string sorting.

methods.name: strcmpAllowNull
methods.description: Performs strcmp comparison allowing null values, noting deprecation in PHP 8.1.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Main method to compare two operands with a specified operator, handling string unwrapping and applying comparison modes.

methods.name: evaluateComparison
methods.description: Evaluates the comparison between operands based on the operator and comparison mode, dispatching to specific comparison methods.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Checks for equality between two operands, considering numeric tolerance and null cases.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if one operand is greater than or equal to another, considering numeric and string comparisons.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if one operand is less than or equal to another, considering numeric and string comparisons.

methods.name: greaterThan
methods.description: Checks if one operand is greater than another, based on lessThanOrEqual logic.

methods.name: lessThan
methods.description: Checks if one operand is less than another, based on greaterThanOrEqual logic.

methods.name: notEqual
methods.description: Checks if two operands are not equal.
